items.headline: Who are the winningest college football coaches of all time?
items.description: From Saban to Paterno, there are many legendary college football coaches. Who has the best career record? Check out who has the most wins now.

items.headline: SEC Now discusses No. 3 Bama's defensive domination of Vanderbilt
items.description: SEC Network's Chris Doering and Benjamin Watson break down the Crimson Tide's win over the Commodores and highlight Keelon Russell powering through injury and Daniel Hill's big game on the ground.

items.headline: No. 7 Alabama survives a sloppy 21-6 win over Vanderbilt behind Keelon Russell
items.description: — Alabama had backup quarterback Austin Mack preparing all week to start at Vanderbilt with Keelon Russell limited by his injured ankle.

items.headline: Injured Russell starts, throws 3 TDs as Alabama survives Vandy
items.description: No. 3 Alabama made a last-second decision to start Keelon Russell in a 21-6 win over Vanderbilt after the quarterback looked better than anticipated in pregame warmups.

items.headline: Chris Doering dissects key storylines in three Week 11 matchups
items.description: Doering weighs Saturday matchups and acknowledges key factors on both sides of the ball, highlighting "one of the hottest team in the country right now" in the No. 17 Gamecocks.
